title: The Great Name Drop (ORIGINAL)
description: In this audio clip I ramble about all the things that were going on in my own little hypno-world during 2016. Much of what is mentioned refers to current events of the time, and is now no longer relevant, so please make sure to read the description in full. "The Great Name Drop" has now finished, and is no longer accepting any new names. With the upcoming rebrand of my Patreon, I want to take the opportunity to look back over my Home feed and include some of the most memorable moments here. So I'll be sharing a few audios to reminisce over past posts, and showcase things you may perhaps have missed over the many years. Original Post It's my six month anniversary of making files! You make me so happy. So I made you something... It has now been half a year since I made my first hypnosis audio, the HFO file, "My Sweet Boy". You... told me you loved it. That I was wonderful. That I invaded your mind and took control. That I should make more. The worship and adoration... was such a power trip. I danced, I floated, I had no choice but to make more. To find out I enjoyed making them. That I loved hearing about what I did to your mind, to your body, to your cock. It's crazy thinking back about what a significant change this has been to my life. The hypnosis community has been so wonderfully welcoming to me, and finding a new kink that just fit me so very very well... fuck. I'm not sure I can properly convey how thankful I am for you guys. The Patreon was created because so many people messaged me on GWA asking me how they could support me. I first created it thinking I might make a few hundred in a few months... and within the first week I was over a thousand. Again. Thank you. If wanting to support me was your goal... you have done that. If you wanted to show me you were devoted to me... you succeeded. If you wanted to make me happy... fuck. You have no idea how happy both your words and the proof that you truly value what I create has made me. You've said nice things all over the internet, shown others how truly effective I can be. You've entrusted your mind to me. Gave in and let me take control for just a little bit... and I loved taking that control from you. So again and again, let it sink deeper and deeper into your mind: YOU ARE AWESOME. So I made you this... It's my six month anniversary of making files! You make me so happy. So I made you something...
